title: Playing in Manetta's band at 13 with Armstrong, Oliver and others
summary: At 13 she joins Manetta's band, whose personnel changed nightly, playing with Louis Armstrong, King Oliver, Kid Howard and drummer Raymond Dugall.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: Can you remember who else was in the band at that time? And what did they have in the band?

Well, at that time, they had... Each night that they played, it seemed they had different musicians, different jobs. I know how the band was. A lot of times it was that way. Sometimes it was Louis Armstrong.
Did he have a regular name for the band? Or just...
Oh, I can think of it.
It seems he always was he had a special name. I can't think of it.

Well, he may know what he called it, but we always called it Mineta's Band. Mineta's Band. Yeah. Well, at times, Louis Armstrong played with us. Then other times, there was Kid Ory. It was... Is that a fellow? I can't think of him right now, but I will get to it.
I played with Joe Oliver. Yeah.
That's right. King Oliver and Kid Howard.
Oh, yeah. That's Kid Howard. He's a kid. He's still playing right now.

I played with them at that time. And, oh, I like Bigard. Oh, yes. Yeah. And the drummer, the drummer. That's right. And there was a Raymond Dugall. Now, I don't know if he's living or dead. No, I don't know. Never know. He was in those times. Well, I played with him, too. Raymond... Dugall.
How was the name spelled? Are those French names? No, it was a French name.
I would not spell it. I don't know him. I don't know him. I would really know him. He played trumpet, too? He played drums. Oh, drums. That's right.
